**Finding: compliant** (preferred position met — no redline proposed).

The agreement imposes no non-solicitation or no-hire restriction on Bluefly:

- **§ 14.8 (Personnel)** — the planner's primary candidate — deals only with each party supervising its own personnel, IBM's right to assign its personnel, and IBM's subcontracting right. No hiring restriction.
- **§ 14.16 (Freedom of Action)** — confirms each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others; if anything it cuts in our favour.
- Full-text searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ" and "induce" surface no restrictive-covenant language; a review of the full section outline shows no restrictive-covenants section at all.

This sits at the **preferred** position (no non-solicit on Customer), so there is nothing to narrow on duration, scope or carve-outs. Worth noting for negotiation posture: if IBM later proposes a mutual non-solicit, our fallback would be personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from the end of their involvement, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire.
